## 3. Summary (short line)
Fifty copy-and-paste prompts, a reusable client brief and a quality checklist, so you can turn real business facts into website copy you can check and edit.

## 4. Description (paste, then use Gumroad's formatting for headings and bullets)

**Stuck at "Lorem ipsum"?**
The design is approved, the build works, and the page still has no words. This kit gives you a structured way to write them with an AI chat assistant, without getting made-up facts back.

**What you get**
- 50 prompts in 10 categories: homepage and hero, About and credibility, service and product pages, calls to action, social proof, SEO and local pages, blog content, brand voice and editing, design handoff and UX copy, and client workflow
- Clear instructions for every prompt: when to use it, which [PLACEHOLDERS] to fill in, and a tip
- A reusable client and business brief that feeds every prompt (fillable Word version included)
- A "Fact Guard" in every prompt: it tells the AI to use only the facts you give it and to flag gaps instead of guessing. It reduces invented details but does not remove the need to check
- A quick-start guide and a "which prompt do I need?" finder
- A complete worked example for a fictional neighbourhood bakery
- A website-copy quality checklist to run before anything goes live

**Files included**
- 84-page PDF with clickable contents
- Plain-text prompt library for clean copy-paste
- Fillable client brief (Word)

**Who it is for**
Freelance web designers and developers who need real copy before launch; small agencies that want a repeatable way to brief and edit copy; small-business owners writing their own site.

**Good to know**
- Works with any modern AI chat assistant (for example ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini). Results vary by tool, and every draft needs a human read and fact check.
- It helps you write drafts. It does not promise rankings, traffic or sales, and it is not legal or compliance advice.
- Single-user licence: use it for your own business and your clients' sites. No resale or redistribution.

## 5. FAQ for the page
**Which AI tool do I need?** Any chat assistant. A free plan is enough to start, though limits and quality vary by tool.
**Do I need to be a writer?** No. The prompts do the structuring; you supply the facts and do the final edit.
**Can I use it for client work?** Yes, for your clients' websites. You may not resell or share the kit itself.
**Will it make my site rank or convert better?** No promises. It gives you a clearer process and a checklist to catch weak or unsupported copy.

## 6. Before you publish (do these yourself)
- Open the PDF once and check it reads well on your screen.
- Confirm Gumroad's current rules for sellers in India (payouts, tax details, KYC) in your account settings.
- Decide your refund policy and enter it where Gumroad asks.
- Send yourself a test purchase or use the preview to see what a buyer receives.
- Add real testimonials to the page only once you have them, with permission.
